_source: creation code built from this repository's sources (forge build --evm-version osaka) for the trading test of tests/anvil_cli.rs: AgentPolicy with budget periods and venues (constructor: the SafeNonceAssert address), CowSwapDecoder (constructor: the settlement), and from contracts/test the plain MockToken and the Settlement stand-in of Trading.t.sol (it asks ERC-1271, pulls the sold token and is its own vault relayer). scripts/test-fixtures.py --write rewrites the entries from the build, and CI fails when one is behind it.
